relationships.subject: Frutalin
relationships.evidence_quote: FTL promotes orofacial antinociception, probably due to the antagonism of TRPV1 channels

relationships.subject: ruthenium red
relationships.evidence_quote: The antinociceptive effect of FTL was prevented by ruthenium red, but not by camphor.

key_findings: Oral nanoencapsulated frutalin produced orofacial antinociception in acute and neuropathic rodent models
Effect blocked by ruthenium red and FTL reduced Trpv1 expression in trigeminal ganglion, suggesting TRPV1 antagonism
